name: session-autopsy
description: Analyze local Claude Code and Codex sessions for tokens, API cost estimates, agent models, compactions, and optimization advice.

interface.shortDescription: Account for session tokens, costs, agents, and context
interface.longDescription: Select a local Claude Code or Codex session and report deterministic token usage, API cost estimates, agent models and efforts, and context compactions. Optional postmortem and improvement analysis runs on a native fresh-context worker with bounded evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $session-autopsy to select a session and report tokens, costs, and compactions.
